question:
Choose the word is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Chastise
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e**. 'Extol'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Chastise"** means to reprimand or rebuke severely, often in a formal or official way.(डांटना)
 
• Out of the given options, the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to "Chastise" is "Extol".
 
• **"Extol"** means to praise enthusiastically or to commend.(प्रशंसा करना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Extol'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain the rest of the options:
 
 
• **"Mulct"** means to impose a fine or extract money from someone.(जुर्माना लगाना)
 
• **"Keelhaul"** means to reprimand or criticize severely. (फटकारना)
 
• **"Berate" **means to scold or criticize someone harshly.(फटकारना)
